ai_summary: Asian Paints reported strong H1 FY27 consolidated net sales and PAT growth of 17.4% and 23.9% respectively, supported by its dominant market position, home décor expansion, and innovation initiatives. However, Q2 FY27 saw significant gross margin compression (down 349 bps YoY consolidated) due to steep raw material inflation and lower price pass-through, also impacting profitability in international and industrial segments. The outlook signals continued challenges from inflation and elevated competitive intensity, suggesting persistent pressure on near-term operating margins despite recent price hikes.
